# Amazon Bedrock

Models in your AWS account, with a Bedrock API key. It has no model list: set the model id by hand.

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Chat API (OpenAI-compatible): returns code that conductor applies |
| Cost | Paid, per token |
| Key | `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` from https://console.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/home#/api-keys |
| Endpoint | `https://bedrock-runtime.{REGION}.amazonaws.com/openai/v1` |
| Default model | `openai.gpt-oss-120b-1:0` |
| conductor name | `bedrock` |
| Provider docs | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/inference-chat-completions.html |
| Checked | 2026-11 |

## Set up

1. Create an API key: https://console.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/home#/api-keys
2. Add it to conductor. It asks for the key (hidden input), region, lets you pick a model, sends one test prompt and adds it to the `docs`, `test`, `review` and `ask` roles:
   ```bash
   conductor add bedrock --region <region>
   ```
3. Check it any time:
   ```bash
   conductor doctor --live
   ```

Or click **Add** on its card in `conductor ui` → Providers.

## Without the wizard

Save the key (hidden input; or pipe it in):
```bash
conductor keys set AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
```

Then add this to `~/.config/conductor/config.json` (all projects) or `.conductor/config.json` (one project):
```json
{
  "providers": {
    "bedrock": {
      "type": "openai",
      "enabled": true,
      "baseUrl": "https://bedrock-runtime.{REGION}.amazonaws.com/openai/v1",
      "apiKeyEnv": "AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK",
      "model": "openai.gpt-oss-120b-1:0"
    }
  }
}
```
List models: `conductor models bedrock --all`. Put `bedrock` in any role's chain in `conductor ui` → Roles & fallback.

The variable name only tells conductor where to find the key; the provider never sees it. To use a key you already keep under another name, set `"apiKeyEnv": "YOUR_VAR"` on `bedrock`.

## Troubleshooting

- **401 / 403**: the key is wrong, expired, or still a placeholder. Run `conductor keys` to see where it comes from, then `conductor keys set AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`.
- **404 or "model not found"**: the model id changed. Pick a current one with `conductor models bedrock --all`.
- **429**: rate limit. conductor puts the provider on cooldown and moves to the next one in the chain; `conductor cooldown --clear bedrock` resets it.
- **Empty reply**: some free routes return nothing now and then; conductor retries once, then falls back.
